description: This Cotswolds circular walk takes you from the town of Broadway to two of the local highlights at Broadway Tower Country Park and Snowshill. The route runs for a distance of 7.5 miles following the waymarked Cotswold Way for much of the route. Beginning in the town of Broadway, the trail guides walkers through a varied landscape of fields, woodlands, and small country villages before looping back. Key landmarks along the way include the 18th-century Broadway Tower, a Grade II listed folly found near the top of Broadway Hill. Later, the trail takes you past St Barnabas Church in Snowshill, a Victorian building cunningly crafted to resemble a medieval structure despite its more recent construction.
